description: Adds 1 million queries to a hosted zone's monthly allowance. Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>', or call with cashu='<token>'. Every request is checked for free before an invoice is made; use check first.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

name: zone_add_queries
title: Add 1 million queries to a zone (200 sats)
